requirements.text: Core-owned atomic claim must compare full binding, epoch, owner, pane/root incarnation and work generation; writer admission and work producer admission share the claim linearization point. No check-then-send gap.

Capture every already accepted write, active submission including delayed Enter, outstanding read traversal, launched child and admitted root/tools/subagents/background/monitor/continuation before claim. Include them in drain; socket ACK or fd flush is not consuming CLI work completion.

After claim, durable sequence queue commits before returning queued receipt. Bound per-target and global queued item count, payload bytes and individual item size. Explicit overflow/backpressure response, no accepted-then-drop. Persist job/owner/binding/generation/route/sequence and recover without replay guessing.

Preserve source order and declared batch atomicity: text+Enter composite, key batches, bracketed paste, prompt submission text/Enter and mouse/key release ownership. Assign sequence once at core authority; multiple RPCs or web promise chains do not provide cross-channel total order.

Release/replay needs exact replacement identity and actual consuming integration sequence acknowledgement; once-only consumption and no loss/duplicate. Missing acknowledgement disables automatic replay and returns recovery.

Resolve current target incarnation and active foreground child; do not redirect pane-addressed queued input to a replacement/other child or reuse display idle/done as drain. New command/start/turn admission must be fenced before spawn or shell injection.

Inventory terminal-response/resize/focus/release bytes separately from prompts. Decide narrowly allowed protocol traffic while fenced without deadlocking preclaim work; bound its queues and bind it to the original incarnation. Never arbitrary-input exemption.
Stale generation/epoch/lease, competing claim and expired/revoked owner reject mutations. Expiry signals recovery, not automatic replay, replacement or effect retry.

Advertise new versioned API methods/capabilities for claim/queued receipts; preserve frozen generation-1 codecs and old method semantics. Legacy ingress must still reach core fence without falsely reporting consumed success.
Secret input bytes are not evidence/log data; durable secret queue requires approved private storage reference or fail-closed nonretaining refusal, not plaintext WAL.

Actual native integration owns root/tools/subagents/background/monitor/continuation admission and consumption ACK. Current generic completion DTOs and metadata hooks are not proof of source enrollment; unknown producers keep readiness false.

bypasses.fact: Native visibility/handoff checks do not consult updater completion ownership.
Attach scroll has no local handoff check in this handler; mouse/raw sibling paths check handoff. Mouse report/page-key fallback still sends bytes.
Direct API handlers write runtime without updater claim consultation; old Ok means enqueue accepted, not consumed.
Separate submission queue and delayed Enter writers persist beyond caller response waiting; write completion not consuming turn acknowledgement.
Synthetic focus can write outside direct user route and before prompt submission.
Disconnect and hidden-surface release-only paths can inject bytes without active visible user input.
Nominal pane/agent read harvest emits wheel batches including restoration.
Terminal responses use shared controls/unbounded write lane, bypass bounded actor data admission.
Agent injection, automatic resume and direct spawn bypass a fence only implemented at pane_input.rs.
Detached/configured background children receive socket/context and may issue RPC; their arbitrary commands cannot be treated as observed native work admission.
HTTP writers bypass local promise serializer; other clients/native/RPC are not ordered by web queue.
Direct sidecar writes bypass web serializer/RPC; eventual core raw input still reaches common actor.
Web-owned delayed Enter and prompt helper keys survive earlier await points; independent text/key RPCs have no atomic cross-channel group.
Drain locks reported registrations only. Binding root start/executable/options unknown; input_fenced=false; metadata hooks do not enroll native scheduler lifetimes.
